A '''''Consular''-class cruiser''' belonged to [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. This transport was used to [[Mission to Mawan|take]] him, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to the planet of [[Mawan/Legends|Mawan]] in [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]].
